## Type of change

- [ ] ✨ **Feature** — new functionality
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug fix** — resolves an incorrect behavior
- [ ] ⚡ **Performance** — improves speed or efficiency
- [ ] ♻️ **Refactor** — restructures code without changing behavior
- [ ] 🎨 **UI** — visual or UX change
- [ ] 🧪 **Tests** — adds or updates test coverage
- [ ] 📝 **Docs** — documentation only
- [ ] 👷 **CI / Build** — pipeline, scripts, or build config
- [ ] 📦 **Dependencies** — bumps or removes packages
- [ ] 🔒 **Security** — fixes a vulnerability or hardens auth/access
- [ ] ⚙️ **Configuration** — env vars, feature flags, settings
- [ ] 🔧 **Chore / Revert** — housekeeping or rollback
